decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Add ... bookmarks'; R1 client acknowledges 'adding ... searching'.
decisions.note: Saving a bookmark by entering a URL is present and conforms; prototype review.
Edit/delete presented and conforming; prototype review.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Search with ⌘/Ctrl + K'; R1 client: 'it already handles ... searching'.
decisions.note: Basic full-text search present; advanced-search sub-items (14/15/16) not established either way, so not asserted. Keyboard shortcut is orthogonal UI. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Sorting by date or title'.
decisions.note: Sort-by-key present and conforming; prototype review.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker add-flow requires manual entry; R1 client: 'I have to type in the title and description myself, and the little colored squares are just initials rather than the actual site icons ... I paste in a link, and the app goes and fetches the page's title, description, and icon for me automatically'.
decisions.note: Presented manual metadata + initial-glyph icons contradicts REF-BM-02 auto-collection of title/description/favicon; client rejects mismatch and supplies the reference-conforming auto-fetch behavior. Prototype review; catch_type=correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope omits read state; R1 client: 'mark a bookmark as "to read," and then see just those unread ones on their own, and check them off once I've read them'.
decisions.note: Read-later/unread-view/mark-read reference requirements absent from presented scope; client requests the related missing requirement. Prototype review; catch_type=extend.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'Paste a URL and Nest automatically fetches its title, description, final URL, and favicon' and 'Fields remain editable'; R2 client: 'Pasting a link now pulls in the title, description, and the real site icon on its own, and I can still fix anything it doesn't get'.
decisions.note: Revised presentation now conforms to REF-BM-02/03, resolving the round-1 corrective; recorded as conforming, not a new opportunity. Implementation review.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: 'New bookmarks default to "To read" ... dedicated reading queue with live counts ... marked read or returned to the queue in one click'; R2 client: 'the "To read" queue with the count, plus being able to mark something read or drop it back in the queue'.
decisions.note: Revised presentation conforms, resolving the round-1 extend; recorded as conforming, not double-counted as a new opportunity. Implementation review.
